The following events took place in '''500 BBY'''.

==Events==
*The [[Yinchorri system]] is first charted, though explorers consider it resource-poor and ill-suited for colonization.<ref name="UAA" />
*The [[Federation of the Double Worlds]] is founded.<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>
*[[Plagen]] is discovered.
*Followers of the [[Sacred Way/Legends|Sacred Way]] colonize [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]].
*[[Karra]] is briefly colonized by the [[Mineral Assets Partnership]].
*Excavation begins on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]]. {{Circa}}
*[[Core Galaxy Systems]] is bought out by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]].
*Colonization of [[Priva]] by the [[Altiri/Legends|Altiri]]. {{Circa}}

==Battles==
*[[Invasion of the Double Worlds]]<ref name="SoF" />
*Start of the [[Daupherm-Boton Conflict]]. {{Circa}}

==Births==
*[[Yanth]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]
